gloss: playing wind instruments; wind instrument performance

definitions.gloss: playing wind instruments; wind instrument performance
definitions.explanation: The act of playing wind instruments by blowing into them. Most commonly encountered in the compound {吹奏楽|すいそうがく} (concert band, wind ensemble music).

examples.japanese: ⟦トランペット→トランペット：07541_toranpetto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹奏|すいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I joined the concert band club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}→吹奏楽：07535_suisougaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A concert band performance took place at the school cultural festival.

notes:
A compound of {吹|すい} (to blow) + {奏|そう} (to play music). Most commonly appears in the compound ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}→吹奏楽：07535_suisougaku⟧ (wind ensemble music / concert band). School concert bands (⟦{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧, often abbreviated as {吹部|すいぶ}) are one of the most popular extracurricular activities in Japanese middle and high schools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}→吹奏楽：07535_suisougaku⟧: concert band, wind ensemble music
- ⟦{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧: concert band club
- ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}→吹奏楽：07535_suisougaku⟧⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧: concert band competition
- {吹奏|すいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to play (a wind instrument)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧: musical performance — general term for playing any instrument
- ⟦{管楽器|かんがっき}→管楽器：07533_kangakki⟧: wind instrument — the instruments themselves
- ⟦ブラスバンド→ブラスバンド：23427_burasubando⟧: brass band — sometimes used interchangeably with ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}→吹奏楽：07535_suisougaku⟧, though technically refers only to brass instruments
